modalities.evidence: MRI images were acquired using a Philips Achieva 3.0T MRI scanner

output.population: Data from thirty-six participants were included in the dataset (15 females and 21 males; mean age= 21.27 (SD = 1.68)); right-handed, no neurological illness
output.summary: fMRI dataset in which Japanese native speakers read newspaper text presented word by word in the scanner, part of a collection using identical stimuli across separate fMRI, MEG and EEG participant groups.
